response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS n FROM player_award a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY 1), s AS (SELECT hand, n, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT hand, n, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(n) AS total_tally, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share;

assumptions.assumption: Each player_award row counts as one award winner (a player with several awards is tallied several times).

The average share is the unweighted mean of the hands' shares across all hands, including the blank/missing group, so it equals 1 divided by the number of hands. It is computed before the filter is applied.
NULL, empty and whitespace-only throws values are merged into one blank group.

alternatives.interpretation: Tally distinct players per throwing hand instead of award rows.
alternatives.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '') AS hand, COUNT(DISTINCT a.player_id) AS n FROM player_award a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY 1), s AS (SELECT hand, n, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT hand, n, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(n) AS total_tally, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share;
